name: Coffee Pub Herald
tagline: A clean, UI-free broadcast view that follows the action.
description: Designate a camera-operator user who gets a UI-free view that automatically follows tokens, for streaming, player displays or a dedicated TV client.
pitch: Turn one Foundry user into a clean, UI-free camera that follows the action automatically, for streaming, a TV display or a second monitor.

features.title: Camera operator
features.text: Designate one Foundry user whose client shows a clean view with the interface hidden.

features.title: Auto token following
features.text: The camera follows the action automatically; no one needs to sit at that client.

features.title: Nine broadcast modes
features.text: Party Spectator, Token Spectator, Combat, Combatant, GM View, Map View, Manual, Mirror player and Follow token.

features.title: Stream overlay
features.text: An MVP leaderboard overlay on Foundry's stream page.

features.title: Studio control
features.text: Works with Coffee Pub Showrunner for OBS camera setup.

features.title: Menubar controls
features.text: Broadcast tools live in Blacksmith's menubar, with mode controls in its secondary bar.

steps: Create a Foundry user for the camera (Player role is usual), enable Broadcast in Herald settings, and set Broadcast User to that user.
Log in as that user in a separate browser window or profile.
Pick Party Spectator from the Herald menubar menu, move a party token to check it, then point OBS or a monitor at that window.
needs: Coffee Pub Blacksmith, installed and enabled first
